baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence al-ard khashiatan, anzalna alayha al-ma, ihtazzat wa-rabat.
baseline_models.mechanism: A low, visibly dormant surface receives water, passes into motion and swelling, and manifests the life that had been unavailable to sight.

activation_trace.role: Earth as a fertile growing medium supplies the substrate whose capacity is initially hidden.
A low, dormant tract supplies the initial state of arrested visible activity.
Water delivered by pouring supplies the activating input to the dormant substrate.
Earth and vegetation stirring into life marks the first observable phase transition.
Increase and elevation supply the expanding second phase of reactivation.
Land made alive by rain names the completed transformation and its causal analogue.

changed_reading.before: A familiar observation that rain makes dry ground grow.
changed_reading.after: A staged activation trace in which apparent lifelessness is latent capacity made visible by a fitting input.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Min ayatihi, tarā, ahyaha, la-muhyi al-mawta.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse makes a seen terrestrial reversal function as evidence for an unseen human reversal: the same agent who crosses the life boundary in the land can cross it for the dead.

activation_trace.role: A manifest marker frames the land-cycle as evidence rather than scenery.
Direct and inward seeing makes the reader inspect the observable premise of the analogy.
Rain-life in the land supplies the demonstrated crossing from dormancy to vitality.
Loss of force and life names the boundary whose reversibility is at issue.
Effective capacity carries the observed act across to the promised reanimation of the dead.

changed_reading.before: A resurrection claim followed by a general assertion of divine power.
changed_reading.after: An empirical-to-eschatological argument: witnessed revival is the local demonstration of capacity to revive the dead.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Wa-rabat and innahu ala kulli shayin qadir.
baseline_models.mechanism: Growth reaches an increased state through proportioned provision; qadir therefore carries both effective capacity and the ability to bring each thing to an apt measure within an exhaustive scope.

activation_trace.role: Nurture and development construe swelling as governed growth rather than undirected expansion.
A thing reaching its bounded amount supplies the proportional aspect of the final predicate.
Deliberate estimation and fitting add ordered process to sheer ability.
Comprehensive inclusion prevents the measured operation from being confined to vegetation.
Every knowable entity supplies the unrestricted object-domain of the capacity.

changed_reading.after: The closing power claim includes exact fitting, nurture, and completion across every entity.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The earth is khashiatan before it rises.
baseline_models.mechanism: Khushu joins a physical low, quiet surface to a posture of yielding; the subsequent motion shows that lowliness can be receptive readiness rather than exhausted finality.

activation_trace.role: Clinging low to the ground supplies the spatial stillness from which receptivity begins.
Yielding humility gives the earth's low posture a live relational valence.
Dormant low land keeps that relational reading materially anchored.
An inward stirring toward energy makes the response compatible with joy rather than mere agitation.
Rising after yielding reverses the assumption that humility and elevation are opposites.

changed_reading.before: Khushu is only a visual synonym for barren stillness.
changed_reading.after: The earth's lowliness is a receptive posture whose answer to descent is energetic elevation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same descent root delivers revelation at the surah's opening and close and water in the focus; revelation is detailed and healing, but only a receptive addressee responds, as humble earth responds to water.

activation_trace.role: Caused descent and delivery anchors the shared transport mechanism in the focus.
Delivered water supplies the physical medium that activates a receptive recipient.
Yielding receptivity anchors the transfer from land-response to hearer-response.
The delivered descent of revelation establishes the first explicit counterpart to delivered water.
Tender mercy qualifies the descending message as life-oriented provision.
Articulation into distinct meanings makes revelation an input that can penetrate and reorganize understanding.
A second revelation-descent closes the lexical frame around the focus water-descent.
Healing and restored soundness specify the life-effect of revelation on a responsive hearer.
Weight in the ear supplies the blocked-reception counterpart to irrigable earth.
Inner blindness names the failure of a sign to activate perception.

structural_cues: The surah opens and later returns to tanzil, while the focus uses anzalna for water.
41:44 opposes healing guidance to blocked hearing and inward blindness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: shared descent language, healing, and blocked reception; inference: water-to-earth supplies a model for revelation-to-hearer; live alternative: the shared root may coordinate divine gifts without making a sustained metaphor.

changed_reading.before: The water-cycle proves bodily resurrection but remains separate from the surah's discourse about revelation.
changed_reading.after: The cycle also models revelatory activation: descent gives life where humility permits reception, while covered faculties remain inert.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earth belongs to a creation that comes willingly and is framed by prostration and praise, whereas arrogant humans claim superior strength; its khushu is therefore obedient responsiveness, and its rising displays commanded life rather than self-exaltation.

activation_trace.role: Humble yielding anchors the earth's physical posture in a relation of obedience.
Its subsequent elevation becomes the result of reception rather than a boast of autonomous height.
The terrestrial counterpart to heaven identifies the same earth as an addressed creature.
Willing compliance supplies the creation-wide disposition later embodied by the humble land.
Self-magnification supplies the human counter-posture enacted upon the earth.
Concentrated strength supplies the rival human claim displaced by the focus claim of total capacity.
Lowering in prostration gives ritual precision to the focus earth's humble posture.
Arrogance immediately before the focus sharpens the contrast between refusal and terrestrial receptivity.
Continuous worship places the focus sign inside an active liturgy of creation.

structural_cues: 41:11 personifies heaven and earth as willingly responsive.
41:37-39 forms a contiguous sequence of signs, prostration, tireless praise, arrogance, and humble earth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: willing creation, prostration, praise, and human arrogance surround the focus; inference: the earth's khushu participates in cosmic obedience; live alternative: khashiatan may remain only a physical description of dry land.

changed_reading.before: The land is low because it is depleted.
changed_reading.after: The land is low yet responsive, enacting the obedience that arrogant humans resist; its God-given rising is the vindication of receptivity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier creation sequence makes, stabilizes, blesses, provisions, measures, completes, and guards; the focus revival is another phase of that ordered provisioning, so final capacity is exercised through exact fit and sequence.

activation_trace.role: Measured planning anchors the closing capacity claim in ordered execution.
Nurtured development supplies the focus outcome of provision correctly applied.
Origination of the earth establishes the same agent and substrate as the focus revival.
The earth as the lower created domain carries identity across creation and reanimation.
Stable, growing good supplies the intended persistence of terrestrial provision.
Earlier measuring of provisions makes the focus qadir echo an enacted design process.
Life-sustaining nourishment identifies what the earth is configured to mediate.
Completed and effective making supplies the endpoint of measured creation.
Explicit estimation names the cosmic scale of the same measured agency.
Guarding what was ordered adds preservation to origination and growth.

structural_cues: 41:9-12 is a phased earth-and-heaven construction sequence.
Q-d-r occurs in the provisioning sequence, its summation, and the focus conclusion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: creation, measured sustenance, completion, protection, and focus growth share one sequence of agency; inference: resurrection is continuous with ordered provisioning; live alternative: qadir may primarily close the verse with unrestricted ability.

changed_reading.before: Revival interrupts nature as a bare miracle.
changed_reading.after: Revival completes a recurrent economy of making, measuring, feeding, preserving, and returning life.

context_deltas.mechanism: Bodies testify, every thing can be made articulate, and signs are shown across horizons and selves until truth becomes clear; the moving earth therefore acts not only as an analogy but as nonverbal testimony to return.

activation_trace.role: A visible marker makes the revived land capable of evidentiary force.
Seeing recruits the observer who receives the land's evidence.
Present witnessing supplies the juridical mode into which material signs can enter.
The body's own covering becomes a witness, establishing that material surfaces can disclose hidden histories.
An articulate indication extends speech beyond ordinary human utterance.
The unrestricted entity class allows earth to belong to the field made evidentially articulate.
Return to a prior state links material testimony directly to the focus promise of revived dead.
Caused showing turns signs into an unfolding disclosure rather than a static inventory.
Manifest signs explicitly reconnect the finale to the focus land-sign.
Far horizons expand the scale of testimony to the external world.
The self as the entity itself supplies the inward scale complementary to the land.
Emergence into clarity names the cumulative effect of outward and inward evidence.

structural_cues: 41:20-21 turns bodily materials into witnesses and pairs first creation with return.
41:53 reprises showing and signs across outer and inner domains.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: material bodies testify and horizon/self signs become clear; inference: the focus earth's motion is a nonverbal witness to return; live alternative: body testimony and natural signs may remain distinct evidentiary scenes.

changed_reading.before: The land is an object observed by a human witness.
changed_reading.after: The land itself performs testimony through motion and growth, while the viewer becomes recipient of that material witness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus swelling can be read as gestational latency: water enters a fertile body, concealed increase becomes visible movement, and life emerges; 41:47 then aligns fruit leaving sheaths with hidden pregnancy and delivery under encompassing knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Fertile earth supplies the receptive body in which concealed growth can occur.
A pregnancy becoming outwardly visible supplies a branch-level bridge from seeing to swelling.
Generative fluid entering a womb supplies the most form-distant input image for gestational activation.
Increase and swelling supply the visible phase of concealed development.
Knowledge as disclosure holds both cosmic timing and hidden biological processes in one frame.
Coming out from concealment supplies the transition from latent life to manifest issue.
Mature fruit supplies the botanical issue of hidden terrestrial growth.
A plant's enclosing sheath supplies the container from which its issue emerges.
Hidden pregnancy and fruit explicitly join biological and botanical carrying.
The female bearer supplies the animate counterpart to fertile earth.
Delivery of a carried life supplies the endpoint corresponding to emergence from the land.

structural_cues: 41:47 coordinates fruit emergence, enclosing sheaths, pregnancy, and delivery in one sentence.
The focus progresses from receptive body through swelling to life before naming resurrection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: fertile earth, swelling, fruit-sheaths, hidden pregnancy, and delivery; inference: resurrection is figured as gestation and emergence; live alternative: the two scenes may simply enumerate separate objects of divine knowledge.

changed_reading.before: Resurrection resembles plants restarting after rain.
changed_reading.after: Resurrection also resembles concealed life carried to term and brought out: emergence and birth, not only regrowth.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated stimulus-response clauses contrast earth and human: water makes humble earth move and grow, while affliction makes the human despair and mercy or favor produces possession-talk and withdrawal; vitality becomes apt responsiveness, not mere reaction.

activation_trace.role: Yielding receptivity supplies the earth's initial disposition toward its incoming gift.
Stirring into energy supplies an affirmative response rather than panic or refusal.
Nurtured growth makes the earth's response productive.
An impact that leaves an effect supplies the adverse stimulus in the human response cycle.
Hope cut off supplies the first maladaptive endpoint.
A second image of severed hope intensifies the collapse under adverse contact.
Tender mercy supplies the beneficial stimulus that the human misattributes as private possession.
A favorable state supplies another life-giving input whose reception is tested.
Turning one's side away supplies the refusal that contrasts with the earth's receptive posture.
Drawing the flank away spatializes the human's self-isolating response to favor.

structural_cues: 41:39 and 41:49-51 repeatedly use conditional or idha stimulus-result sequencing.
The earth's received good yields growth; the human's received good yields appropriation or withdrawal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: parallel stimulus-response syntax and opposed outcomes; inference: the earth becomes an ethical comparator for human receptivity; live alternative: the later human portrait may concern ingratitude without deliberately personifying the focus land.

changed_reading.after: Life also means fitting response to what descends or touches: humble earth is more alive in reception than the reactive, self-enclosed human.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This uses the packet's non-dominant r-w-y mapping for the focus sight-root, so it is form-distant and must not be presented as the lexical meaning of tara; it remains anchored to tara, water, and signs, and prose should mark it only as an exploratory branch resonance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Tarā stands directly before the dry-earth and water sequence.

activation_trace.role: Satiation after thirst lets the commanded seeing resonate as perception itself being refreshed.
Carrying and bringing water lets sight function experimentally as the carrier of the life-giving sign.
Actual water delivery keeps the perceptual hydration resonance attached to the verse's material process.
The manifest sign supplies what perception receives and by which it is renewed.
The later caused showing of signs extends the exploratory image of perception relieved of thirst.

changed_reading.before: Seeing is a neutral channel that reports the revived land.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the sign irrigates perception itself: the viewer is another dry recipient brought to cognitive life.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain structural analogy triggered by the liquid-discharge branch of d-f-a in 41:34, not a claim that social conduct is lexically rain; it remains anchored to the focus input-and-transformation sequence, and downstream prose should label it as a heuristic resonance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Water arrives upon a depleted field and converts its state into life and increase.

activation_trace.role: A beneficial input delivered onto a recipient anchors the social analogy in the focus process.
Life as benefit allows revived relation to remain tied to the focus life-language.
Removing harm by a counteraction supplies the social intervention.
A single discharge of rain or liquid gives that counteraction an irrigation-like branch image.
Affectionate alliance supplies the transformed relational state.
Intimate nearness specifies how far the formerly hostile field has been renewed.

changed_reading.before: The focus transformation belongs only to soil and future bodies.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, a well-chosen beneficial counter-input can irrigate a deadened social relation until hostility becomes intimacy.

strongest_changes: The shared descent root turns rain-revival into a model of revelation activating receptive hearers.
Creation's willing obedience and the worship sequence recast the low earth as responsive humility opposed to human arrogance.
The early measured-provisioning sequence makes resurrection continuous with ordered creation rather than an isolated display of force.
Fruit, sheath, pregnancy, and delivery make emergence or birth a second live model of resurrection.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet converted a compact agronomic proof into several coexisting mechanisms: revelatory reception, cosmic obedience, measured provision, material testimony, gestational emergence, and an ethical test of responsiveness.
remaining_uncertainties: The revelatory-irrigation reading may be deliberate lexical architecture or only a productive recurrence of descent language.
The gestational model is strongly sequenced by 41:47 but depends partly on form-distant focus branches.
Hydrated perception and social irrigation should remain explicitly exploratory rather than become lexical claims.
